sections.Profile:
"Lucky Man" and "Monte Carlo" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Nordamatic in 1976. "Lucky Man" is a two-player game, while "Monte Carlo" is its single-player counterpart. Both machines feature three flippers, a single pop bumper, a five-bank drop target, ten standup targets, and dual inlanes on both the left and right sides.

- Manufacturer: Nordamatic
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Dual Theme, Gambling, Casino, Original Theme, 1970s
